book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, not from any translation

sentences.ar: سائق عربة عجوز واقف بالتلج من المسا.
sentences.en: An old cab driver stood in the snow from the evening.

words.caphi_raw: y T a l l i J

sentences.en: The snow covered his shoulders and his horse’s.

words.caphi_raw: k a S aa f e

sentences.ar: ابنه مات هالأسبوع، وهو بده يحكي.
sentences.en: His son had died that week, and he wanted to speak.

sentences.ar: ركب معه ضابط، وقال له: ابني مات.
sentences.en: An officer rode with him, and he said: my son died.
The officer said: how sad, and fell silent.

words.caphi_raw: s a k k i t

sentences.ar: بعدها ركبوا تلات شباب وهم يضحكوا.
sentences.en: After that three young men rode with him, laughing.

words.caphi_raw: b a 3 i d h a

sentences.ar: حاول يحكي، وواحد قال: كلنا رح نموت.
sentences.en: He tried to speak, and one said: we will all die.
They got out without having heard him.
He went back to the stable at the end of the night.

words.caphi_raw: y 2 a kh kh i r

sentences.ar: واحد نايم هناك، حاول يصحيه ويحكي.
sentences.en: Someone was sleeping there; he tried to wake him and talk.

sentences.ar: الرجل لف على التاني وكمل نوم.
sentences.en: The man turned over and went back to sleep.

words.caphi_raw: k a m m i l

sentences.ar: راح عند حصانه وحط إيده على راسه.
sentences.en: He went to his horse and put his hand on its head.

sentences.ar: قال: لو كان عندك ولد ومات، شو كنتي تعملي؟
sentences.en: He said: if you had a son and he died, what would you do?

sentences.ar: وقعد يحكي له كل إشي من الأول.
sentences.en: And he sat telling it everything from the beginning.
